boxes.meaning: eagerly competing to do something first

english.note: Use this when people eagerly volunteer or vie with one another to do something.
Use this when people eagerly compete or volunteer to be the one who does something first.

examples.english: The students enthusiastically vied to perform on stage.

examples.english: The kids eagerly volunteered to answer the question.
